name: Asou Kanako
source:
Kanako is a groupie that loves bands and lives for chasing them. While she is a compassionate and cheerful person, her passionate personality brings out a side of her that goes on the offensive when somebody gets their hands on something or someone she likes. She is good at hairstyling and doing make-up.
